name: video-project
description: A content-engine video project. Packages come from the engine (node_modules is a junction to content-engine/runtime/node_modules): never npm install here.

scripts.preinstall:
node -e "console.error('
This project uses the content engine packages. Do not npm install here.
If node_modules is missing, run:  ce link
');process.exit(1)"
scripts.deliver: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/video.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 256k -movflags +faststart out/delivery.mp4
